videos.title: UNBOXING: Google Pixel 11 (Pistachio)
videos.description:
Unboxing the new Google Pixel 11.

The basic Pixel 11 has the fewest new changes. You can tell it apart from the Pixel 11 Pros with its glossy glass back and matte aluminum frame. Google also says it shrank the camera bar, which now has a black “visor” that extends all the way across it, by 40%.

It comes in four colors: Pistachio, Hibiscus, Frost, and Obsidian.

You get the same 6.3-inch 120Hz display with up to 3,000 nits of peak brightness and built-in Pixelsnap magnets for wireless charging

videos.title: Hands On with Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold: Lighter, Better Screen, More Gemini
videos.description:
Google’s book-style foldable, the Pixel 11 Pro Fold, is still very expensive, but there are some upgrades that make it better than its predecessor. It comes in just two colors: Olive and Obsidian.

Durability matters a lot for foldables, so Google made the back out of a new glass composite that it claims is nearly impossible to break. There’s a new gearless hinge that protects the inner screen, which, by the way, also has a reduced crease.
